brief:
Three NSE filings establish that MRPL, Tata Communications and Polycab each submitted results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, on 14-15 October 2026. All three carry PRIMARY_EXCHANGE_METADATA_ONLY status: the facts are the existence, date and scope of the filings, nothing more.

No verified financial line items were supplied. OCR excerpts cover cover letters and board-meeting language only and are explicitly flagged unverified, so no numbers may be adopted. Tata Communications' limited review report with an unmodified opinion is a procedural disclosure. Polycab's document retrieval failed, leaving the thinnest record of the three.

Gaps: result tables, segment and sector metrics, cash conversion and balance-sheet detail for all three; full document text for Polycab. Any explanation of operating performance is hypothesis pending verification. Dossiers are empty per fast-lane scope; verification of primary tables sits with Codex at the next comparable quarter.
